out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) chest freezer in the touching room was observed with a broken interior liner
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPAIR/REPLACE CHEST FREEZER.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed measuring cups for sugar and spices encrusted in sugar and spice.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food shall be cleaned at any time when contamination may have occurred. PIC MOVED MEASURING CUPS TO THE DISH AREA TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED.
